description: The latest 10 posts from a company's LinkedIn page: text, date, likes, comments and shares, images and link. Filter by how recent. Use it when: You need what a company has been announcing on LinkedIn: launches, hiring pushes, events or how its posts perform. Not for: Personal profiles (company pages only) or the people who reacted and commented. Returns: Up to 10 posts: text, posted date, likes, comments and shares, image links, the post link and whether it is a repost. Typical time: about 8 s. Price: $0.029 per search (up to 10 posts), charged only on success. One call = up to 10 posts.

companyUrl.description: LinkedIn company page URL, e.g. https://www.linkedin.com/company/stripe

postedWithin.description: Only posts newer than this; default any
